center.title: Application Center
center.description: See current usage, startup behavior, network activity, history, and uninstall actions under one application identity.
center.boundary: Local data is linked only by stable application identity. Commands and file contents are never stored.

overviewTitle: What has the most impact now
title: Application resource impact
description: CoreRobin groups helper processes under familiar application names, then totals CPU, memory, and disk activity.

selected.title: How {{name}} affects the computer
selected.cpu: Processor use is the main impact right now ({{value}}). If it stays high, the computer may feel slow, hot, or use more power.
selected.memory: Memory is the main impact right now ({{value}}). Action is only needed when memory pressure and swap activity are also present.
selected.disk: Disk activity is the main impact right now ({{value}}). Sync, downloads, and builds can all cause temporary reads and writes.
selected.balanced: No single resource stands out right now, so the overall impact is low.
selected.systemSafety: This is a system component. Do not quit it directly; inspect professional evidence first if something looks wrong.
selected.appSafety: This is a regular app. CoreRobin will never close it automatically, and every quit action still requires confirmation.

energy.title: GPU and relative energy
energy.description: Shows GPU activity and relative energy clues for active processes when the operating system provides them.
energy.collapsedDescription: Inspect graphics load on demand; it is not continuously sampled or used for health decisions.
energy.gpuUnavailable: This platform or hardware does not expose a supported GPU metric.
energy.processUnavailable: This platform does not expose per-process energy impact.
energy.noProcessActivity: This sample found no distinguishable process energy activity.
energy.boundary: These values are relative scores reported by the operating system, not watts or energy. Zero values are omitted; refreshes every 15 seconds while expanded.

uninstall.scanningHint: Checking applications, disk usage, and identity information. Larger apps may take a little longer.
uninstall.title: Complete Uninstall Assistant
uninstall.description: Finds the app itself and leftovers that can be clearly attributed to it. Nothing is handled until you confirm each path.
uninstall.unsupportedTitle: The system app catalog is unavailable
uninstall.unsupportedDescription: The supported macOS, Windows, or Linux application catalog could not be read. Retry after the operating system finishes updating its app or package database.
uninstall.localOnly: Read locally; the inventory is never uploaded
uninstall.cachedInventory: Showing the local cache from {{time}}; refresh anytime
uninstall.searchPlaceholder: Search name, app identifier, or path
uninstall.preparingPlan: Verifying app identity and support files…
uninstall.planBoundary: Quit this app first. Only paths that can be clearly attributed to it are listed; app-name guesses are excluded.
uninstall.bundleOnlyBoundary: This app does not provide enough identity information, so CoreRobin removes only the path- and structure-verified app itself without guessing at support files.
uninstall.skippedDescription: The current state of these paths could not be confirmed safely, so the assistant will not touch them.
uninstall.selectDescription: The assistant creates a path-by-path plan before final confirmation.
uninstall.cannotPrepare: A safe plan cannot be created for this application
uninstall.dialogDescription: Review the app bundle and related data one by one. Moving to Trash is the recoverable default.
uninstall.outcomeMovedToTrash: Moved {{name}} to Trash; handled {{count}} items and {{size}}. It remains recoverable until Trash is emptied.
uninstall.outcomePartial: The uninstall for {{name}} did not fully finish; handled {{count}} items and {{size}}.

removed.trashDescription: The app has left its original location and can be restored until Trash is emptied. Refresh the inventory to remove this record.
removed.permanentDescription: The app was deleted directly from disk and cannot be restored from Trash. Refresh the inventory to remove this record.
removed.partial: The application bundle was removed, but some related items could not be handled.

unavailable.generic: This application cannot be uninstalled under the current safety rules.
unavailable.current_application_protected: CoreRobin cannot uninstall itself while it is running.
unavailable.application_bundle_identifier_missing: The application does not provide enough identity information.
unavailable.application_bundle_invalid: The application bundle is incomplete or unsupported.
unavailable.application_bundle_not_allowed: Only top-level apps in an Applications folder are supported.

errors.application_identity_changed: The application identity changed. Refresh the inventory and try again.
errors.application_bundle_unavailable: The application is unavailable. Confirm that it is still in the same location.
errors.application_artifact_unavailable: An item changed before confirmation. Refresh the uninstall plan.
errors.application_bundle_identifier_missing: The application's identity could not be verified.

trashWatcher.title: Watch for apps moved to Trash
trashWatcher.description: Optional local check every 30 seconds. It only offers leftovers that can be clearly attributed and never deletes anything automatically.
trashWatcher.empty: No app bundle is currently waiting in this user's Trash.
trashWatcher.error: Trash could not be checked right now.
trashWatcher.planBoundary: The app itself is already in Trash. This plan contains only existing support data that can be clearly attributed to it.

safety: Selecting an app only opens its resource evidence; every quit action still requires separate confirmation.

nativeUninstall.boundary: The operating system package catalog owns this app. CoreRobin will pass only a verified, short-lived package identity to the native uninstaller.
nativeUninstall.elevationRequired: The operating system may request administrator approval
nativeUninstall.relatedData: Associated data is not guessed or deleted automatically. The package manager decides which installed files belong to this app.
nativeUninstall.revalidate: Package identity is checked again immediately before execution.
nativeUninstall.dialogDescription: CoreRobin will start the verified package-manager method. Any authorization prompt belongs to the operating system.
nativeUninstall.dialogBoundary: The frontend never supplies an executable path or command line.
nativeUninstall.elevationPrompt: A Windows UAC or Linux PolicyKit prompt may appear. Cancelling it is reported separately from failure.

outcome.succeeded: {{name}} was removed by the operating system.
outcome.cancelled: The system uninstall for {{name}} was cancelled.
outcome.failed: The system uninstaller could not remove {{name}}.
outcome.restart_required: {{name}} was removed; the operating system requested a restart.

unavailable.protected: CoreRobin or a protected system component cannot be removed from this screen.
unavailable.portable: No trusted package-manager identity was found. The item remains read-only.
